Hi Priya,

Following up on two outstanding invoices that landed on our side this month: invoice 7721 (EUR 96,400) and invoice 7722 (EUR 12,150). Our AP team has held payment because the invoices were billed to the UK entity but CloudMuse will be using the platform in Germany and Sweden — their treasury is asking for clarification on VAT treatment and proof for the reverse-charge claim.

We pushed for quick internal approval but our CFO (James) wants confirmation of:
- Redwood's VAT registration and whether the charges are outside UK VAT scope;
- a breakdown showing which entity is being billed and the supporting VAT evidence (sales ledger, tax form);
- an explicit staged payment plan if we cannot clear both invoices by the end of this month.

We are trying to avoid a service interruption, but AP is on a hard stop until James signs off. Can you confirm what you can provide today and whether Redwood can accept a 50/50 staged payment with the second tranche by Sep 15?

Thanks — Elena

Elena Martinez

2) VAT evidence: attaching a zip with the VAT registration and a short ledger extract referencing invoice 7721.
3) Staged payment: we're willing to accept a 50/50 staged payment as a one-time accommodation — first tranche (EUR 54,275) now and second tranche (EUR 54,275) by 2028-09-15, conditional on the VAT evidence being uploaded to your treasury portal and a signed acceptance of the mutual action plan.

Proposed next steps:
- Elena / James: confirm acceptance of the staged plan by EOD today so we can instruct collections to release the first tranche payment window.
- Marcus: I'll hand the MAP link (below) and DocuSign envelope for signature.
- Kim: if we don't get confirmation by tomorrow morning, escalate for an exec touch (I know James is the final approver).

Attachments: vat-evidence.zip (contains VAT certs + ledger extract)

1) Tranche 1: CloudMuse pays EUR 54,275 within 5 business days of signature of the MAP and confirmation that the VAT evidence is uploaded to your treasury portal (we received a copy as attachment).
2) Tranche 2: EUR 54,275 paid by 2028-09-15. If tranche 2 is delayed beyond 5 business days after 2028-09-15 we will apply the standard late fee and escalate per the collections SOP.
3) VAT evidence required now: Redwood EU VAT registration certificate (attached previously) plus your treasury portal confirmation screenshot or equivalent. Once received, we will instruct our finance team to accept the tranche 1 payment.
4) For visibility: Marcus will prepare a 2-slide exec summary should you need to coordinate with your CFO; Kim is on standby to prepare our collections memo only if we don't get confirmation by COB tomorrow.

Please sign the mutual action plan here: https://app.redwood.com/mutual-action/DEAL-8321 and the DocuSign envelope here: https://docusign.com/ENVELOPE-48392.

If you accept, reply with the confirmation sentence: "CloudMuse accepts staged payment terms and will upload VAT evidence within 24 hours." That short reply is sufficient for us to open the tranche 1 payment window.
